description:
Refactor the 'buildObservationSegment' method in 'HL7MessageBuilder.java' to improve performance. 

The current implementation uses inefficient String concatenation ('+=') inside a loop, which causes performance issues with large datasets. 

Your task:
1. Open the 'MediLogExport' project in the Eclipse workspace.
2. Locate 'src/main/java/com/medilog/export/HL7MessageBuilder.java'.
3. Refactor the code to use 'java.lang.StringBuilder' (or StringBuffer) instead of String concatenation.
4. Ensure the output format remains exactly the same.
5. Run the existing JUnit tests ('HL7MessageBuilderTest.java') to verify correctness.
6. Save your changes.
